{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify completed orders and exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
completed_mask = data['status'] == 'completed'
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Filter data: completed orders, excluding QA orders
filtered_data = data[completed_mask & ~qa_mask]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = filtered_data.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Output the results
print(f'Channel revenue: {total_revenue_by_channel.to_dict()}')
print(f'Channel with highest revenue: {total_revenue_by_channel.idxmax()}')"}
